smartteamShield.SmartTeamPort: Student-facing RJ ports on the SmartTeam shield.
smartteamShield.analogPinForPort: Return the primary analog-capable signal pin for a SmartTeam shield port.
smartteamShield.digitalPinForPort: Return the primary digital signal pin for a SmartTeam shield port.
smartteamShield.portIndex: Return a stable array index for a SmartTeam shield port.
